hypothesis: A residual multi-view codebook can add held-out teacher-view and text-ranking capability without relearning or perturbing the already strong SurfaceRegion V2 canonical path. Exact fallback inclusion and explicit token-gauge supervision remove the two structural failure modes of the rejected from-scratch V3.

representation.slot_count_reason: The frozen authority exposes at most three teacher views; three learned hypotheses preserve that capacity while the additional slot is an exact V2 fallback.
representation.canonical_token: bitwise frozen V2 output on the caller-provided RADIO input and reliability
representation.residual_conditioning: pooled context from the same frozen V2 evaluated on per-token L2 RADIO directions, with reliability passed unchanged
representation.residual_parameterization: base-direction tangent residual plus independent exp(tanh(delta_log_norm)) gauge ratio
representation.initialization: all residual slots have an exact frozen-V2 forward value with a straight-through zero branch
representation.legacy_marginal_safety: returned priors are one-hot on slot0; codebook-max is an explicit separate route

training.data_and_splits: identical frozen 32/8 scene-disjoint ScanNet caches and 806/101 query-disjoint generic text banks used by the rejected V3
training.set_matching: exact permutation matching between the three learned residual slots and up to three valid teacher views; slot0 never consumes teacher capacity
training.set_cost: descriptor cosine + 0.25 * summary-token direction cosine + 0.25 * SmoothL1 log token norm
training.unmatched_slot_rule: a learned slot unmatched on a one-view or two-view row is supervised back to the exact frozen fallback
training.query_response: masked hard maximum over query-independent slot descriptors for both teacher and student
training.warmup: three epochs of gauge-aware residual set matching before response or scene-ranking objectives
training.optimizer_scope: residual heads and slot embeddings only; V2 remains eval and requires_grad false
training.seed_policy: run seed0 canary first; seeds1/2 only if seed0 passes the structural and held-out generic gate

checkpoint_selection.among_feasible_epochs: maximize teacher-best-slot cosine gain, then minimize response SmoothL1
checkpoint_selection.no_feasible_epoch: reject candidate and retain frozen V2; do not select a least-bad epoch for promotion

generic_gate.multiseed_requirement: mean gate passes and at least two of three seeds pass every noninferiority gate

benchmark_opening_rule.full_lerf_gate: four-scene macro improves at least 0.01 and no scene drops more than 0.01
benchmark_opening_rule.spin9_nvos_gate: frozen strict result is noninferior within 0.002 before any shared-task improvement claim

failure_response: If the generic response/ranking gate fails despite exact fallback and improved teacher-set fidelity, stop the codebook branch and move to confidence-factorized source-completion unary and/or rebuild caches with explicit coverage, dispersion and gauge channels.
